name: Zoom Video Communications
y2026_hot: Zoom maintains a significant share in the hybrid-work video conferencing market, despite rising competition, thanks to its global platform and strong brand.
origin: Founded to address the frustration of poor video-conference quality, especially high-latency and ease-of-use issues in enterprise communications.

milestones.detail: Eric Yuan founded Zoom in San Jose, California, after leaving Cisco.
Initial version of Zoom was released for SMB customers, gaining early traction.
Zoom debuted on NASDAQ raising $250M, marking a major funding milestone.
Global COVID-19 pandemic accelerated adoption, reaching 345M daily users.

turning_points: 疫情导致需求爆炸，企业加速迁移到Zoom
failures: 2022年安全漏洞导致多家机构数据泄露
2023年平台遇到多起停机事件，用户信任受挫
keys: 免费基础套餐驱动用户增长
强安全加密与合规支持
lessons: 要持续创新功能以防止被竞争取代
快速扩张需保持品牌声誉和数据安全
